Maria (eng-platform): Quick sync — I'm about to ship a tiny SDK bump that assumes /v1/generate keeps the response envelope fields stable for at least 90 days. Can we confirm which fields are contract-safe? :eyes:

Kevin (eng-runtime): Short answer: id, model, choices, and usage are intended to be stable. We might deprecate the optional `metadata` blob in a later patch, but no removals planned in the next 90d.

Maria (eng-platform): Great. Can you call out any subtle shape/typing changes that would be breaking (e.g., moving a scalar -> object)? I'll add to the upgrade notes.

Kevin (eng-runtime): Breaking changes would be: renaming top-level keys, changing types (string -> object), or removing choices[].index. Adding new optional fields is fine. Also watch out for structured error envelope changes.

Sam (sdk): Pinged — I can add defensive parsing in the SDK (tolerate unknown fields, prefer optional chaining). Quick question: do we guarantee choices[] order? We rely on order in a few places.

Kevin (eng-runtime): Yes order is stable for the same request/seed. We don't randomize choices order server-side. If we do a later multi-choice reranking feature that changes ordering semantics we'll announce it and add a header.

Maria (eng-platform): Awesome. Lina — product wants to know if we can shorten the deprecation notice window if we need to remove `metadata`. What's the minimum lead time?

Lina (product): For enterprise customers we'd prefer 60 days notice + migration guide. Public SDK consumers: 30 days might be risky. Can we do a staged plan?

Kevin (eng-runtime): Plan we use: 60d public deprecation + 30d stablization + canary flag for opt-in removal. So total ~90d from announce to full removal for non-enterprise. That aligns with Maria's SDK timeline.

Maria (eng-platform): Perfect. For the PR checklist (sam plz review):
- confirm SDK will not crash on unknown top-level fields
- add a unit test with an extra `metadata` object in the response
- ensure we read usage if present but tolerate missing usage

Sam (sdk): On it. I'll open a PR by EOD. Will add tests and a short migration note.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: eng-runtime/service-a v2.4.1 -> canary (10%) at 2026-03-19T09:00Z. Watch latency and error-rate dashboards.

Maria (eng-platform): Thanks deploy-bot. Kevin — once canary is healthy, can you post a quick summary in this thread (latency, 5xx)? I'll tag the SDK PR in release notes.

Kevin (eng-runtime): Will do. Current action items: (1) Kevin: confirm no hidden type changes in upcoming builds; (2) Sam: SDK defensive parsing + tests; (3) Maria: bump notes and communicate deprecation window to customers; (4) Lina: prepare enterprise comms.

Sam (sdk): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/482 (draft) — tests added, awaiting runtime confirmation.

Maria (eng-platform): Thanks everyone. If anyone thinks the 90d plan is too long/short speak now. Otherwise I'll mark this as the plan and follow up in the release notes. :thumbsup:
